rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Short 20 m kerb with houses 10-11 m away beside a school zone.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses sit 10 m and 11 m from the kerb on the same side, with homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street with a few cars parked along the kerb; no gate. Room is ordinary parallel parking.
drivers.traffic: Residential street leading to a school zone and roundabout; busy at drop-off times.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both kerbs, but the dwellings are too close to this short stretch.

flags: Dwelling within about 10 m of the whole section
sun_shade: Street trees cover the north and east of the kerb, giving morning and midday shade.
